source.name: HIFLD Open 'Power Plants' (Plants_gdb; final HIFLD Open release, re-hosted on ArcGIS Online item 6e0bdfea762046988469da10407f844f)
source.vintage: HIFLD Open Power Plants, final HIFLD Open release (official service last edited 2023-09-21, 13,233 features; max SOURCEDATE 2022-06-02, max VAL_DATE 2022-07-18)

fields.name: hifld_id
fields.description: HIFLD Power Plants record ID: the layer object ID (FID 1..13233, contiguous, in the source's PLANT_CODE order). The layer has no other unique ID because PLANT_CODE is duplicated for some plants. Primary key.

fields.name: eia_plant_code
fields.description: EIA plant code (source PLANT_CODE parsed as integer; null when PLANT_CODE is a non-EIA HIFLD code such as 'NA02715'). Join key to eia860_plants.plant_code. NOT unique: HIFLD carries duplicate records for a few plants.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Plant name (source NAME); the placeholder 'UNKNOWN' -> null.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Operating status (source STATUS; EIA-860 status codes: OP operating, SB standby, OS/OA out of service, RE retired, CN cancelled, IP indefinitely postponed, P planned, L regulatory approvals pending, T approved/not under construction, U/V under construction, TS construction complete/not yet operating).

fields.name: plant_type
fields.description: Generation technology description(s) (source TYPE); multiple technologies are joined with '; '.

fields.name: primary_fuel
fields.description: Primary fuel / energy source code (source PRIM_FUEL; EIA energy source codes such as NG, SUN, WAT, MWH).

fields.name: total_mw
fields.description: Operating (nameplate) capacity of the plant (source OPER_CAP); -999999 -> null.

fields.name: net_gen_mwh
fields.description: Annual net generation (source NET_GEN); may be negative for storage/pumped hydro; -999999 -> null.

fields.name: sourcedate
fields.description: Date of source data (source SOURCEDATE, UTC).
